answer: Cold-start dwell requirement. An agent identity earns full write weight only after ~10 days of traffic with irregular gaps on a human-scale horizon. Its loop must hold at a whisper rate, and admission scores shape, not count: inter-arrival entropy, clock drift, and idle-gap spread all have to differ per identity. Clones from one host share pacing, so they cluster and stay read-only. Passing demands real timber per identity: separate hardware, independent drift, ten days of idle wall-clock. A thousand agents costs a thousand machines and a thousand waits.
